visual.general_description: Line chart with day-after-HSCT x axis showing three laboratory curves (Hb, reticulocytes, LDH) and rows of treatment symbols for IVIG, meprednisone, daratumumab, MMF and ruxolitinib.
visual.detailed_description: White-background chart without a printed title. The x axis is labelled "Day after HSCT" with ticks every 7 from 182 to 280. The left y axis is "Hb [g/L]" with ticks 20 to 120 in steps of 20; the first right axis is "reticulocytes [%]" with ticks 0 to 22 in steps of 2; the second right axis is "LDH [U/L]" with ticks 200 to 800 in steps of 100. A legend line inside the plot area names three curves: green "Hb [g/L]", red "reticulocytes [%]" and blue "LDH [U/L]". The curves run from just after the day 182 tick area (about day 187) to about day 276 and have no point markers and no printed data values. The green Hb curve starts low at the left, dips, rises to a first local peak, falls to a trough near the day 203 to 210 ticks, rises with a small dip near the day 217 to 224 ticks, then flattens and creeps up toward the upper right. The red reticulocyte curve starts low, rises to a first peak, falls to a trough near the day 203 tick, rises to a much taller peak near the day 210 tick, falls to a shoulder near the day 217 to 224 ticks and then declines slowly toward the right edge. The blue LDH curve starts high at the upper left and falls steadily, flattening around the day 210 to 224 ticks and continuing to decline gently to about day 276. Along the top are six cyan squares (the first is two overlapping squares); below them five green ovals; below them yellow star symbols (an overlapping cluster of at least three at the far left and one near the day 273 tick) and purple downward triangles (one near day 196, one near day 210, two overlapping near days 224 to 226 and one near day 276). Three dark red ovals sit at mid height: two side by side near days 224 to 226 and one near day 276. The bottom legend reads "IVIG" (yellow star), "meprednisone" (cyan square, spelled as printed), "Daratumumab" (green oval), "MMF" (purple triangle) and "Ruxolitinib" (dark red oval). No panel letters, patient identifiers, dates or arrows are visible.

pixel_observations: The x axis is labelled "Day after HSCT" with ticks from 182 to 280 every 7 days; the curves cover roughly days 187 to 276.
Three coloured curves are plotted: green Hb [g/L] (left axis), red reticulocytes [%] and blue LDH [U/L] (right axes); none has markers or printed values.

Treatment symbols are drawn in rows above and across the plot: six cyan squares (first is two overlapping), five green ovals, yellow stars (an overlapping cluster of at least three at the far left and one near the day 273 tick), five purple triangles (two overlapping near days 224 to 226) and three dark red ovals (two near days 224 to 226, one near day 276).
Legend entries printed at the bottom: IVIG, meprednisone, Daratumumab, MMF, Ruxolitinib.

The blue LDH curve falls from the upper left toward the lower right; the red reticulocyte curve has two peaks, the second taller; the green Hb curve rises from a low start with a trough between the two reticulocyte peaks and a flatter rise afterwards.
No patient identifiers, names, dates, scanner text or faces are visible.
